preferences.text: The supplied strategy defines Motivating Reset as the brand essence and describes an attentive, insightful, supportive, warm personality. Treat these as strategic intentions, not product-efficacy proof or locked campaign copy.

The draft visual guide proposes warm contemporary Indian architecture, tactile materials, natural light, integrated greenery, usable space and restrained red. This is exploratory direction only; it is not approved guidance.
Consider a visual story moving from pause toward connection or renewed participation; this interprets the strategy and remains a creative proposal, not a demonstrated product outcome.
Official-site observations show a red symbol and uppercase DUROFLEX wordmark. Treat this as observed identity, not a complete production specification; confirm current masters and lockups.
The collected official website shows a broad product range and varied commercial/category treatments. These dated observations are not permanent brand rules.
Supplied interior images may inform spatial exploration, such as integrated work and sleep zones or a garden-facing bedroom. They are inspiration, not verified Duroflex SKUs or approved sets.

preserve: Treat the supplied positioning as strategy, not independently validated product or health efficacy.
Keep exact selected product appearance, colour, construction, branding and controls truthful; reference interiors do not establish product identity.
Keep the supplied Visual World Guide's draft status visible. Its example rules, approval language and scorecard are not approved specifications.
explore: Explore calm, usable domestic spaces and tactile material relationships as proposals, adapting any scene to the exact selected product.
Explore ordinary rest, connection and readiness as human moments without implying a proven product-caused transformation.
Explore category-specific settings only after the exact SKU, variant, channel and approved claims are known.
avoid: Do not present draft palette, typography, logo treatments, shot classes or room recipes as mandatory brand rules.
Do not invent exact fonts, colour values, product facts, claims, offers or portfolio adoption.
Do not turn positioning language, consumer research, web marketing or reference imagery into product efficacy proof.
Do not copy another brand's identity or treat supplied reference imagery as permission to reuse third-party identity.
unknowns: No campaign brief, selected SKU, variant, channel, audience, offer or approved claim set is specified.
Final logo masters, typography, tagline lockup and production identity specifications remain unresolved.
Adoption of the proposed Restore, Recharge, Oasis and Recalibrate portfolio architecture is not established.
The draft guide contains unresolved inconsistencies, including environmental red use and serif-looking examples versus its sans-serif direction.
No placement-specific requirements or approved production assets are supplied for this task.
guide.decisionSummary: Fresh Duroflex context only: preserve sourced strategy and product truth; treat the visual-world guide as draft and site patterns as observations. No mandatory visual execution rules or campaign requirements are established here.
